sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是“隐藏的大脑”。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: Richard Davidson was a 22-year-old graduate student
sentences.zh: 理查德·戴维森曾是一名22岁的研究生，

sentences.en: when he went to India to attend an intense meditation retreat.
sentences.zh: 当时他去印度参加了一个高强度的冥想修行营。

sentences.en: He quickly found the journey had a surprise in store for him.
sentences.zh: 他很快发现，这次旅程为他准备了一个惊喜。

sentences.en: The bus that we were taking up into the Himalayas
sentences.zh: 我们当时坐着上喜马拉雅山的巴士

sentences.en: got stuck in a landslide, which was pretty scary, actually.
sentences.zh: 遭遇滑坡被困住了，说实话，挺吓人的。

sentences.en: Richie and the other passengers found themselves pinned on the edge of a cliff.
sentences.zh: 瑞奇和其他乘客发现自己被困在悬崖边缘。

sentences.en: On one side was a mountain wall.
sentences.zh: 一边是山壁。

sentences.en: On the other, a sheer drop.
sentences.zh: 另一边是万丈深渊。

sentences.en: Rocks rained down around them
sentences.zh: 碎石在他们身边雨点般落下，

sentences.en: and rain pounded against the bus window.
sentences.zh: 雨水猛烈地敲打着巴士的车窗。

sentences.en: They felt paralyzed.
sentences.zh: 他们感到动弹不得。

sentences.en: And then?
sentences.zh: 然后呢？

sentences.en: This unbelievable scene transpired
sentences.zh: 发生了这样一个难以置信的场景：

sentences.en: where another bus pulled up from the other side
sentences.zh: 另一辆巴士从对面开过来，

sentences.en: and we exchanged.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了换乘。

sentences.en: We literally took our belongings.
sentences.zh: 我们真切地带着所有的行李，

sentences.en: We walked over this landslide into this other bus
sentences.zh: 走过这片滑坡路段，上了另一辆巴士。

sentences.en: And this other bus on these single-lane narrow roads that are literally 4,000 or 5,000 feet drop with no rail had to go backward for maybe a mile or two until it got to a place where it can turn around.
sentences.zh: 而这辆巴士在这些单车道窄路上行驶，旁边就是四五千英尺高、没有任何护栏的悬崖，它不得不倒车大约一两英里，直到找到一个能够掉头的地方。

sentences.en: That trip to India would eventually prompt Ritchie to see his own life as a bridge across a divided road.
sentences.zh: 那次印度之行最终促使瑞奇将自己的人生视为一条横跨分裂道路的桥梁。

sentences.en: One side of the road was represented by his teachers at Harvard and mainstream psychology.
sentences.zh: 路的这一边代表着他在哈佛的老师和主流心理学。

sentences.en: The other was represented by his meditation teachers in the United States and India,
sentences.zh: 另一边则代表着他在美国和印度的冥想导师，

sentences.en: including, eventually, the Dalai Lama.
sentences.zh: 其中最终还包括达赖喇嘛。

sentences.en: Both the psychologists and the meditators were engaged with the life of the mind,
sentences.zh: 心理学家和冥想者都在从事心灵的研究，

sentences.en: but from different sides.
sentences.zh: 但却来自不同的阵营。

sentences.en: The scientists wanted to study the brain from the outside in,
sentences.zh: 科学家们希望从外到内研究大脑，

sentences.en: using scans and monitors and probes.
sentences.zh: 使用扫描仪、监视器和探测器。

sentences.en: The meditator said,
sentences.zh: 而冥想者则说：

sentences.en: Hang on, what we experience during our contemplative practices
sentences.zh: 等等，我们在观修实践中体验到的东西，

sentences.en: cannot be captured by crude photos of the brain.
sentences.zh: 是无法用粗糙的大脑照片捕捉到的。

sentences.en: How can a Polaroid camera capture the complexity of an ocean?
sentences.zh: 拍立得相机怎么能捕捉到大海的复杂性呢？

sentences.en: As we explored in part one of the story,
sentences.zh: 正如我们在本故事第一部分中探讨的那样，

sentences.en: Ritchie soon discovered that both sets of practitioners
sentences.zh: 瑞奇很快发现，这两派实践者

sentences.en: viewed the other with deep suspicion.
sentences.zh: 都对对方抱有深深的猜忌。

sentences.en: If you missed that episode, I recommend you go back and listen to it firSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你错过了那一期节目，我建议你先回去听听。

sentences.en: Today on the show, we examine how Ritchie Davidson eventually found a way to synthesize two very different approaches to the mind.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目中，我们将探讨瑞奇·戴维森最终如何找到一种方法，将对心灵的这两种截然不同的方法融合起来。

sentences.en: It would take courage and patience, like that dramatic mountain bus rescue.
sentences.zh: 这需要勇气和耐心，就像那次戏剧性的山地巴士救援一样。

sentences.en: Bridging the Divided Road, this week on Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 《架起分裂之路》，本周“隐藏的大脑”。

sentences.en: In 1992, Ritchie Davidson and his colleagues carried 5,000 pounds of scientific equipment with them to India.
sentences.zh: 1992年，瑞奇·戴维森和他的同事们带了5000磅重的科学设备前往印度。

sentences.en: With the blessings of the Dalai Lama,
sentences.zh: 在达赖喇嘛的祝福下，

sentences.en: Ritchie was hoping to use his scientific instruments
sentences.zh: 瑞奇希望利用他的科学仪器

sentences.en: to capture what was happening in the minds
sentences.zh: 来捕捉高阶西藏冥想者

sentences.en: of highly experienced Tibetan meditators
sentences.zh: 在偏远山间修行营中，

sentences.en: in remote mountain retreats.
sentences.zh: 其内心究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: Over the course of three weeks,
sentences.zh: 在三周的时间里，

sentences.en: literally zero of the practitioners
sentences.zh: 竟然没有哪怕一个修行者

sentences.en: agreed to allow us to put electrodes on their head.
sentences.zh: 同意让我们把电极贴在他们的头上。

sentences.en: They had this view that somehow
sentences.zh: 他们有这样一种观点，总觉得

sentences.en: if we put electrodes on their head,
sentences.zh: 如果我们把电极贴在他们头上，

sentences.en: it's going to put something into their head.
sentences.zh: 就会有什么东西被放进他们的脑子里。

sentences.en: And we explained to them that the electrodes
sentences.zh: 我们向他们解释说，这些电极

sentences.en: don't transmit electricity.
sentences.zh: 并不传输电流。

sentences.en: They simply pick up electricity.
sentences.zh: 它们只是收集电流。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, they were skeptical
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们仍然持怀疑态度，

sentences.en: and they didn't want to participate.
sentences.zh: 并且不愿意参与。

sentences.en: It was a complete bust, total and complete buSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一次彻底的失败，完完全全的失败。

sentences.en: Ritchie and his team regrouped, dejected.
sentences.zh: 瑞奇和他的团队沮丧地重新集结。

sentences.en: But they had one further humiliation in store for them.
sentences.zh: 但更大的羞辱还在等着他们。

sentences.en: And in the last couple of days, the Dalai Lama said, we have all this equipment and, you know, you're here to do this research.
sentences.zh: 在最后几天，达赖喇嘛说，我们有这么多的设备，你知道的，你们来就是为了做这项研究。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, the young monks will be interested in what you're doing.
sentences.zh: 他说，年轻的僧侣们会对你们正在做的事情感兴趣的。

sentences.en: And he asked if we would please give a lecture.
sentences.zh: 他问我们是否能做个讲座。

sentences.en: And we said, of course, happy to give the lecture.
sentences.zh: 我们说，当然，很乐意做这个讲座。

sentences.en: And so what we decided to do is since we didn't get to use the equipment to test these long-term practitioners,
sentences.zh: 所以我们决定，既然没能用设备去测试这些长期修行者，

sentences.en: we're going to do a demonstration with the equipment for these young monks.
sentences.zh: 我们就用这些设备为年轻僧侣们做一次演示。

sentences.en: Rather than ask one of the monks to serve as a volunteer,
sentences.zh: 与其让其中一位僧侣做志愿者，

sentences.en: one of the researchers, neurobiologist Francisco Varela,
sentences.zh: 不如让其中一位研究人员、神经生物学家弗朗西斯科·瓦雷拉

sentences.en: stepped forward to be the guinea pig.
sentences.zh: 挺身而出当小白鼠。

sentences.en: So the way it worked is that I put the electrodes on Francisco's head
sentences.zh: 所以它的运作方式是，我把电极戴在弗朗西斯科头上，

sentences.en: and then we were going to show all of these young monks
sentences.zh: 然后我们向所有这些年轻的僧侣展示

sentences.en: what brain activity looked like on a computer monitor.
sentences.zh: 电脑显示器上的脑电活动是什么样子的。

sentences.en: Ritchie told the monks that he would show them the inner workings of the brain
sentences.zh: 瑞奇告诉僧侣们，他将通过测量弗朗西斯科的大脑电活动

sentences.en: by measuring Francisco's brain electrical activity.
sentences.zh: 来展示大脑的内部运作机制。

sentences.en: Specifically, the scientists told the monks
sentences.zh: 具体来说，科学家们告诉僧侣们，

sentences.en: they could demonstrate what compassion looked like
sentences.zh: 他们可以展示当进行科学测量时，

sentences.en: when you measured it scientifically.
sentences.zh: 同情心是什么样子的。

sentences.en: Compassion, of course, is a core interest of Buddhist practice.
sentences.zh: 同情心自然是佛教修行的一个核心兴趣点。

sentences.en: The scientists figured that they could teach the monks a thing or two
sentences.zh: 科学家们认为，他们可以向僧侣们传授一些关于

sentences.en: about the neural signature of compassion.
sentences.zh: 同情心神经特征的知识。

sentences.en: So there were about 200 monks
sentences.zh: 当时大约有200名僧侣

sentences.en: who were sitting on cushions on the floor,
sentences.zh: 坐在地上的垫子上，

sentences.en: very dutifully sitting and we were futzing with the electrodes and it took a while those were the
sentences.zh: 非常乖巧地坐着，而我们在摆弄电极，花了不少时间——那是过去的日子，

sentences.en: older days where it took like 45 minutes to get it all set up and to have the EEG activity the
sentences.zh: 大概要花45分钟才能把一切设置好，并让脑电图活动、

sentences.en: brain electrical activity nicely displayed on the computer monitor finally we were ready and we sort
sentences.zh: 大脑电活动很好地显示在电脑显示器上，最后我们准备好了，我们稍微让开了一点，

sentences.en: of parted and so they can now see Francisco clearly with this electrode cap on his head and
sentences.zh: 这样他们现在就能清楚地看到弗朗西斯科头上戴着这个电极帽，

sentences.en: the 200 monks just burst out laughing they were hysterically laughing and we thought that they
sentences.zh: 而那200名僧侣突然哄堂大笑，他们笑得前仰后合，我们以为他们笑是因为，

sentences.en: were laughing because you know francisco looked kind of funny with the electrode cap on his head
sentences.zh: 你知道的，弗朗西斯科头上戴着电极帽看起来有点搞笑，

sentences.en: and it turned out that we didn't realize this at the time but it was pointed out to us the next day
sentences.zh: 结果我们当时并没有意识到这一点，但第二天有人向我们指出，

sentences.en: that that's not what they were laughing about they were laughing at the fact that we were talking
sentences.zh: 他们笑的不是这个，他们笑的是我们居然在谈论

sentences.en: about studying compassion
sentences.zh: 研究同情心，

sentences.en: and we're putting electrodes on the head
sentences.zh: 却把电极贴在头上

sentences.en: and not on the heart.
sentences.zh: 而不是贴在心脏上。

sentences.en: That's what they were laughing about.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们笑的原因。

sentences.en: The neuroscientists thought it was obvious
sentences.zh: 神经科学家认为这显而易见，

sentences.en: that anything related to behavior
sentences.zh: 任何与行为相关的事情

sentences.en: had to be entirely shaped by the brain.
sentences.zh: 都完全是由大脑塑造的。

sentences.en: The monks were equally confident.
sentences.zh: 僧侣们同样信心十足。

sentences.en: The scientists didn't know
sentences.zh: 科学家们根本不知道

sentences.en: what they were talking about.
sentences.zh: 自己在说些什么。

sentences.en: On their way out of India,
sentences.zh: 在离开印度的路上，

sentences.en: Ritchie asked the Dalai Lama for advice.
sentences.zh: 瑞奇向达赖喇嘛寻求建议。

sentences.en: The trip had been a failure
sentences.zh: 这次旅行从头到尾

sentences.en: from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 都是一次失败。

sentences.en: The scientists and the monks were starting with different assumptions,
sentences.zh: 科学家和僧侣们有着不同的出发假设，

sentences.en: and they came from entirely different cultures.
sentences.zh: 而且他们来自截然不同的文化。

sentences.en: And he said, well, what you need to do then
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，那么你们需要做的

sentences.en: is to study practitioners who've been teaching in the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 是去研究那些一直在西方教学的修行者。

sentences.en: When Ritchie got home to Wisconsin, he followed the Dalai Lama's advice.
sentences.zh: 瑞奇回到威斯康星州后，听从了达赖喇嘛的建议。

sentences.en: He recruited meditation practitioners
sentences.zh: 他招募了熟悉美国的冥想修行者

sentences.en: who had familiarity with the United States to come into his lab.
sentences.zh: 来到他的实验室。

sentences.en: They were mostly people who were teaching in the West,
sentences.zh: 他们大多是在西方教学的人，

sentences.en: But all of them had really deep meditation experience.
sentences.zh: 但所有人都有着极其深厚的冥想经验。

sentences.en: All of them, one of the requirements for the study
sentences.zh: 所有人——该研究的要求之一是

sentences.en: is that they have completed at least one three-year retreat
sentences.zh: 他们必须完成至少一次为期三年的闭关，

sentences.en: and doing at least eight hours of practice every day for three years.
sentences.zh: 并且连续三年每天至少进行八小时的修行。

sentences.en: Ritchie recorded their brain electrical activity,
sentences.zh: 瑞奇记录了他们的脑电活动，

sentences.en: and he observed something unusual.
sentences.zh: 并观察到了不同寻常的现象。

sentences.en: We observed these very high-amplitude gamma oscillations.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到了这些非常高振幅的伽马振荡。

sentences.en: Gamma is a very fast frequency of brain electrical activity.
sentences.zh: 伽马波是一种非常快速的大脑电活动频率。

sentences.en: It's a frequency of about 40 cycles per second.
sentences.zh: 它的频率约为每秒40个周期。

sentences.en: You and I have gamma activity.
sentences.zh: 你和我都有伽马活动。

sentences.en: Everybody has gamma activity.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有伽马活动。

sentences.en: But it's typically seen for really short periods of time in most of us.
sentences.zh: 但对大多数人来说，它通常只持续很短的一段时间。

sentences.en: And it's seen during moments of insight.
sentences.zh: 并且它出现在灵光一现的时刻。

sentences.en: And so, for example, if you've been working on a problem and suddenly something comes to you, during that sort of quarter of a second where you just have this flash,
sentences.zh: 因此，举个例子，如果你一直在攻克一个问题，突然间你灵光一现，就在那大约四分之一秒的闪念瞬间，

sentences.en: we often see this kind of gamma activity.
sentences.zh: 我们经常会看到这种伽马活动。

sentences.en: Gamma activity is also seen at the moment where different elements of a percept come together.
sentences.zh: 当感知觉的不同元素汇聚在一起时，也会出现伽马活动。

sentences.en: So, for example, imagine biting into a juicy apple.
sentences.zh: 所以，例如，想象咬一口多汁的苹果。

sentences.en: When you imagine that, there are different elements that often occur to most people.
sentences.zh: 当你想象这个场景时，大多数人脑海中通常会出现不同的元素。

sentences.en: You can imagine the tactile sensation of your teeth digging into a crisp apple.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象牙齿咬进脆苹果时的触觉。

sentences.en: You can imagine the juice sort of being released and the taste.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象汁水四溢的感觉和味道。

sentences.en: You can imagine the color of the apple.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象苹果的颜色。

sentences.en: You can hear the sound of the crunch.
sentences.zh: 你可以听到清脆的咀嚼声。

sentences.en: So all of these different elements come together in a single unified percept.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些不同的元素汇聚成了一个单一的、统一的感知。

sentences.en: It turns out that gamma activity that is synchronized in different parts of the brain
sentences.zh: 事实证明，在大脑不同部位同步的伽马活动

sentences.en: is the core mechanism that binds those different elements together
sentences.zh: 是将这些不同元素结合在一起的核心机制，

sentences.en: to create a unified percept in our experience.
sentences.zh: 从而在我们的体验中创造出一个统一的感知。

sentences.en: So they had long durations of gamma activity.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们拥有持续时间很长的伽马活动。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just when they were meditating, but it was also during their baseline state.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅是在他们冥想时，在他们的基线状态下也是如此。

sentences.en: Long-term practitioners of meditation often report heightened states of perception and awareness.
sentences.zh: 长期练习冥想的人经常报告说，他们的感知和觉察状态得到了提升。

sentences.en: They report seeing connections that most of us might miss.
sentences.zh: 他们报告说，能够看到我们大多数人可能会错过的联系。

sentences.en: That twig on the tree isn't just a twig.
sentences.zh: 树上的那根小树枝不仅仅是一根树枝。

sentences.en: It's also a leaf, a fruit, and a new branch, just in embryonic form.
sentences.zh: 它还是叶子、果实，以及以胚胎形式存在的新枝条。

sentences.en: change in the buddhist tradition is the only constant meditators say they often have a deep
sentences.zh: 在佛教传统中，变化是唯一的常态，冥想者说他们常常对变化的本质有着深刻的理解，

sentences.en: appreciation of the nature of change including changes that transform the worlds of life
sentences.zh: 包括那些将生命世界转化为死亡与再生世界的变化。

sentences.en: into the worlds of death and regeneration the gamma burst richie saw offered a clue to what
sentences.zh: 瑞奇看到的伽马爆发为理解大师级冥想者头脑中可能发生的事情提供了一条线索。

sentences.en: might be happening in the minds of master meditators the amazing thing about this was
sentences.zh: 最神奇的是，

sentences.zh: 与脑电活动中的大多数其他信号不同，肉眼就能

sentences.en: eye.
sentences.zh: 直观地看到这一点。

sentences.zh: 大多数时候，当我们做这种研究时，我们必须用

sentences.zh: 精妙的计算机算法。你知道，经过几个月的处理，我们得到了一个发现，即

sentences.zh: 一个统计学上的发现，在这里它在视觉上显而易见。

sentences.en: And it was so apparent that we thought
sentences.zh: 而且它是如此明显，以至于我们认为

sentences.zh: 起初它是一个伪影。你知道，我们以为出了什么问题。

sentences.zh: 我们以为那是

sentences.zh: 肌肉伪影。

sentences.zh: 我们确信它不可能是真的，因为它是如此之大、如此显著。

sentences.zh: 我们不得不花整整一年时间进行各种对照实验，来说服自己

sentences.zh: 这确实是真的。

sentences.zh: 这一发现堪称惊人。

sentences.zh: 里奇发现冥想

sentences.en: at least in some circumstances, by some practitioners, could lead to structural
